claim: Patchline ships a provenance-preserving deduplication proving identical migrations are counted once. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the deduplication claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make provenance-dedup-gate`.
